steps.note: Open the single-stage event setup screen where the event-type configuration drawer is available.
Select RFP in the configuration drawer.
Provide the required title for a create flow without changing the configuration subject.
Confirm RFP is the selected event type.
RFP should not require or show auction strategy configuration.

steps.note: RFP should not require awarding type configuration.
Switch to RFQ and set the supported lot awarding mode.
Confirm RFQ is the selected event type.

steps.note: Verify RFQ offers Lot and Line awarding choices.
Switch to the Reverse Auction/Auction configuration and select a valid strategy and awarding mode.
Confirm the reverse-auction event type is represented by the product's Auction label.
Reverse Auction should show auction strategy configuration.
Verify all documented auction strategy choices are offered in the strategy control.
